requirements.requirement: RFP-26-0791BC is titled AI Governance Solution.
Proposal due October 1, 2026 no later than 1:00 p.m. Pacific Local Time.
Late submittals are not accepted.
Electronic submittal is preferred.
Electronic proposal first page must be digitally signed by an authorized representative.
List the RFP number in the email subject line for identification.
Hard-copy first page must carry an original signature by an authorized representative.
Hand-delivered proposals are accepted only at the County Purchasing Division.
Active RFP documents and addenda are controlled through the County Purchasing Portal; viewing/downloading requires login.
County general guidance requires written questions via ProcureWare clarification or Purchasing email; answers are issued by addendum.
Mirror reports September 15, 2026 1:00 p.m.; official solicitation-specific deadline not anonymously verified.
Exact electronic-submission destination/address must come from the official solicitation packet.
Required proposal forms, certifications, acknowledgements, and attachment set are unknown without the packet.
Minimum proposer qualifications and experience thresholds are unknown without the packet.
Reference count, recency, eligibility, and format are unknown without the packet.
Evaluation factors, point weights, interviews/demos, and award basis are unknown without the packet.
Detailed technical scope appears in mirrors but cannot be treated as controlling until the official packet is retrieved.
Security, privacy, public-records, data residency, and Microsoft/GCC-specific contractual requirements are unknown without the packet.
Pricing schedule, basis, currency instructions, optional items, and taxes are unknown without the packet.
Insurance limits and endorsements are unknown without the packet.
Contract term and County contractual clauses must come from the official packet; mirror claims are non-authoritative.
Prime/subcontractor disclosure, consent, responsibility, and reference-credit rules are unknown without the packet.
Page limits, section order, file naming/size limits, and copy counts are unknown without the packet.
Addenda location is known, but acknowledgement mechanics and currently issued addenda cannot be verified anonymously.
